content.text:
Crash reproduced and fully documented. Here's the summary:

## Reproduction Steps
1. Launch `dev.lincforge.benchtarget` on the Pixel 8 Pro (`<REDACTED-1>`, Android 16).
2. From the home screen, tap **Catalog**.
3. Scroll down the catalog list to **Item 013** (13th entry) and tap it to open its detail screen.
4. Tap the **Export** button.
5. App immediately crashes and drops back to the home launcher.

Note: Export works fine on Items 001–012 (and presumably 014+) — only **Item 013** triggers the crash, which matches the "somewhere in the early part of the list" description since it's the last item visible without scrolling on this screen size.

## Crash Exception
```
java.lang.IllegalStateException: export buffer not initialized
	at dev.lincforge.benchtarget.core.ExportPolicy.export(ExportPolicy.kt:11)
	at dev.lincforge.benchtarget.ui.ScreensKt.DetailScreen$lambda$0$0$0(Screens.kt:90)
	at androidx.compose.foundation.ClickableNode.onPointerEvent-H0pRuoY(Clickable.kt:1009)
	... (full Compose/View touch-dispatch chain) ...
	at android.REDACTED-PKG(ActivityThread.java:9333)
```
Process: `dev.lincforge.benchtarget`, PID 8840 — `FATAL EXCEPTION: main`, uncaught.

Root cause (confirmed in source, `target-app/app/src/main/java/dev/lincforge/benchtarget/core/ExportPolicy.kt:8-11`): the export path has a hardcoded `check(item != "Item 013")` guard that unconditionally throws for that one catalog item.

## Additional Evidence
- Screenshots at each step (Catalog list, Item 013 detail screen with Export button, post-crash home-launcher screen showing the app was killed).
- Full logcat capture of the crash saved to `~/T/nerve-output/e0096b38fcb1/<REDACTED-1>_0014_logcat.txt`.
- Screen recording of the full repro (navigation → tap Export → crash → return to launcher): `/Users/<REDACTED>/.linc/nerve/recordings/android_<REDACTED-1>_1783562261.mp4`.
- `nerve_inspect` confirmed the process was no longer running (`"running": false`) immediately after the tap.
